summary: The change implements issue #2129: a new [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute lets the source generator write a formatter body into a user-declared partial class for a type in another assembly, with optional surrogate-based key/membership control, four new analyzer diagnostics (MsgPack019-MsgPack022), generator wiring, template and doc updates, and new tests. The solution builds, but the full suite fails: GeneratedMessagePackFormatterTests.FormatterMustImplementFormatterOfT fails because a formatter class with no IMessagePackFormatter<T> makes the generator crash with CS8785 instead of reporting MsgPack020. In GeneratedFormatterCollector.Collect the check `if (formatterInterfaces.Length > 1)` lets the zero-interface case fall through to `formatterInterfaces[0]`, which throws. The end-to-end execution tests for external types were not run, so the feature itself cannot be confirmed from the given evidence.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The feature code is present and the build passes, but the MsgPack020 diagnostic path crashes the generator (test failure) and the external-type execution tests were not run, so the requirement cannot be confirmed met.

evidence.quote: Feature Request: Allow generation of Formatter for a type in a referenced assembly

findings.title: Formatter without IMessagePackFormatter<T> crashes the generator instead of reporting MsgPack020
findings.claim: GeneratedFormatterCollector.Collect only reports MsgPack020 when more than one IMessagePackFormatter<T> interface is implemented (`if (formatterInterfaces.Length > 1)`). With zero interfaces it falls through to `formatterInterfaces[0].TypeArguments[0]`, which throws on the empty array and fails the generator (observed as warning CS8785: Generator 'MessagePackGenerator' failed to generate source), so the documented diagnostic is never produced. This is exactly the failure in GeneratedMessagePackFormatterTests.FormatterMustImplementFormatterOfT, which failed in both the targeted run and the full suite.
findings.suggested_fix: Change `if (formatterInterfaces.Length > 1)` to `if (formatterInterfaces.Length != 1)` so a formatter with zero IMessagePackFormatter<T> interfaces reports MsgPack020 and returns null instead of indexing an empty array.
